messages:
maya: Heads-up — bumped a q4b-int4 canary today and noticed the promptset dedupe step produced a dense cluster of near-duplicates. n-gram suppression looks like it didn't trigger for long code snippets and stack traces. thinking we need a short re-dispatch + small golden refresh.

sam: thanks for the flag. can you paste a minimal repro or a sample?

maya: sample pasted below. you'll see repeated call stacks with tiny var renames. seems the tokenizer compaction + int4 quantization changed tokenization boundaries so our fuzzyhash missed them.

maya: ```
input: "Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/runner.py", line 42, in <module>
    run_job(job_id)
  File "/app/worker.py", line 101, in run_job
    result = process(ctx)
variable names differ but structure identical
```

oli: ahh that explains it. q4b-int4 truncates some multi-byte tokens differently. we should rescore candidates with the float baseline and then re-run fuzzyhash + ngram suppression. low-risk: only affects curation pipeline, not prod traffic.

anna: I can take labeling coordination. propose: spawn a small requeue for the "longcode" sampler, labeler batch size 50, assign to senior labelers, ETA 4 hours. ok? :thumbsup:

sam: sounds good. add a config flag so this is repeatable. e.g.
```
# tools/dedupe.py
--rescore-model q6b-fp32 
--bucket longcode 
--fuzzy-threshold 0.78 
--label-batch 50
```

maya: that looks right. also add `--ngram-window 5` temporarily. will help catch token-boundary shifts.

curation-bot: job queued: dedupe-redispatch-1719997001 by maya. status: queued.

oli: one more: when we refresh golden, don't expand golden with all these near-duplicates. we should only promote samples where rescoring increases baseline delta > 0.15. otherwise we'll bloat the goldset.

anna: noted. labeling rubric update: mark "near-dup": keep/merge/suppress. will share short guide in the thread.

maya: sharing quick checklist: 1) run rescoring job 2) run fuzzyhash with --ngram-window 5 3) create label batches with tag longcode 4) labelers mark keep/merge/suppress 5) golden refresh only for keep with delta>0.15 6) update promptset metadata with dedupe-run id.

sam: can someone kick off step 1? I'm on infra PR.

oli: I'll run the rescoring now on a small shard. will report throughput and any unexpected OOMs.

curation-bot: job started: dedupe-redispatch-1719997001-shard-0. workers=8.

oli: quick report: rescoring finished on shard-0, no OOMs, avg latency 42ms/token for q6b-fp32 baseline rescoring. produce index: s3://redwood-curation/dedupe/1719997001/shard-0.ndx

anna: thanks. I'm creating label batches and pinging the team in labeler channel.

maya: awesome — after label sweep let's do a roll-forward canary to validate quality delta on the new q4b-int4 with this curated set. aim to keep the rollback path trivial. :eyes:

sam: agree. small canary, monitor hallucination rate and latency. please tag the canary with dedupe id.

anna: labeler guide posted: short bullets + examples. assigning 4 senior labelers now. ETA ~3.5h.

curation-bot: label batches created: 14 batches, total 700 samples. assigned to team: labelers-senior.

maya: perfect. I'll follow-up with a brief postmortem if we find reproducible tokenization drift. thanks all. :party_parrot:
